title: Network Access Standards Applied to Out-of-Network Prior Authorization
content:
**Access standard.** Prairie Ridge Health Plan sets, for each Prior Authorization class, whether approving an out-of-network service requires that no in-network provider can deliver it within the access standard, the distance in miles beyond which the nearest in-network provider is considered unavailable, the calendar days beyond which the earliest in-network appointment is considered unavailable, whether the out-of-network provider must sign a single case agreement before the start date, and the member's cost share for an authorized out-of-network service beyond the in-network copay.

| Class | Approval requires no in-network provider available | Distance standard (miles) | Appointment wait standard (calendar days) | Single case agreement before start date | Member cost share beyond the in-network copay (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No | 0.00 |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No | 0.00 |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No | 0.00 |
| Home Health Services Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No | 0.00 |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No | 0.00 |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | No | 0.00 |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | Yes | 60 | 30 | Yes | 0.00 |

**Both sides of the Out-of-Network Services Authorization standard (hypothetical).**

| Hypothetical nearest in-network provider | Hypothetical earliest in-network appointment | Distance standard of 60 miles | Wait standard of 30 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 75 miles away | 10 days out | beyond 60 miles: considered unavailable | within 30 days: available |
| 40 miles away | 45 days out | within 60 miles: available | beyond 30 days: considered unavailable |
| 40 miles away | 10 days out | within 60 miles: available | within 30 days: available |

In every class the member's cost share for an authorized out-of-network service is 0.00 beyond the in-network copay.
